description: This is a Python source code file implementing AES-GCM encryption utilities with key versioning for secure credential storage. It includes an EncryptionManager class with methods for encrypting and decrypting data, as well as a function to ensure MongoDB indexes are created for token and audit collections.

classes.name: EncryptionManager
classes.description: A class providing methods for encrypting and decrypting data using AES-GCM, with support for key versioning and environment-based configuration.

methods.name: "EncryptionManager" from_env()
methods.description: Constructs an EncryptionManager instance using environment settings, loading the base64-encoded encryption key and key version.

methods.name: str encrypt(self, plaintext: str, aad: Optional[bytes] = None)
methods.description: Encrypts plaintext data into a JSON envelope containing the key version, nonce, and ciphertext.

methods.name: str decrypt(self, envelope: str, aad: Optional[bytes] = None)
methods.description: Decrypts a JSON envelope produced by encrypt(), returning the original plaintext.

methods.name: None ensure_core_indexes()
methods.description: Asynchronously creates MongoDB indexes on token_records and audit_events collections to optimize lookups.
